findings.label: Scan runnable is the Worker itself
findings.detail: The scan-and-summarize is the Worker's ExecuteAsync (single pass), not a separate entry point. Acceptable for this phase; watcher/continuous mode and any separate CLI are deferred to a later phase.

findings.label: No-transport fallback only synthetic
findings.detail: The pendency path is proven with a synthetic non-BRF XML because real data is 100% BRF with transport. Revisit with a real non-BRF sample before relying on the fallback in production, per the ressalvas in MAPEAMENTO-DADOS.md.

findings.label: Parse errors surfaced only as log warnings
findings.detail: VarredorPasta collects per-file parse errors and the Worker logs them, but there is no structured error/pendency report yet. Fine for a read-only scan phase; the relatorio de erros requirement lands in a later phase. The VarredorPasta catch branch is not covered by an automated test (real scan reported 0 errors).
